title: Boundary of Binary Tree
summary: The boundary of a binary tree consists of the root, the left boundary, the leaves from left to right, and the reverse right boundary.
statement: The boundary of a binary tree consists of the root, the left boundary, the leaves from left to right, and the reverse right boundary. The left boundary includes the root's left child, and if no left child exists, it is empty. If a node on the left boundary has a left child, it is included. If a node has no left child but a right child, the right child is included. The leftmost leaf is not part of the left boundary. The right boundary mirrors the left but for the right subtree. Leaves are nodes without children, excluding the root. Given a binary tree's root, return its boundary values.
constraints: Return root, nonleaf left boundary, all leaves left-to-right, then reversed nonleaf right boundary.
Do not duplicate leaves or the root.
An empty tree returns an empty list.
